items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: There was a guy named Matthew Holland, he was the first chair man

ctx.x: Yeah, sure. Well, when you switched to trumpet, you were like about two years on the alto?

Yeah, about two years on the alto, and some the guys left. There was a guy named Matthew Holland, he was the first chair man, and he studied very hard at home on his horn, and finally he went out and started playing with the adults around town, you know.
